integrity: Finite exhaustive proof by two standalone algorithms: Python memoized first-move recursion and C++17 breadth-first reachable-state traversal, with 17 independent natural symmetry orbits as a check. Independent external audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: An exact finite classification of labelled weight-four distributions on the Petersen graph, not a theorem about an infinite graph family; priority relative to unindexed historical enumerations is uncertain. The optimal threshold four is an antecedent, not new.
title: The 175 optimal rubbling distributions of the Petersen graph
